string.text: Application of a protective coating to the internal parts significantly reduces wear.
Extended barrel, threaded for mounting a 5.7x28mm suppressor.
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improves accuracy while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Narrow beam flashlight is essential for night raids, as well as to seach and clear poorly-lit rooms. Does not interfere with the laser sight and can be installed along with it.
